Venomous_Telson_Stinger.description: The venomous telson stinger, a fearsome appendage of arachnid origin, extends from the tail of its bearer, its sleek, segmented form ending in a wicked, hollow tip filled with potent neurotoxins. Each flex of its muscular tail increases the bearer's striking range and physical might, allowing them to unleash devastating poison through precise, deadly strikes.

Elongated_Sensory_Flagellum.description: The elongated sensory flagellum, a prehensile and whip-like appendage, extends from the arachnid's abdomen, bristling with sensory organs that enhance its perception and grant it the eerie ability of blindsight, allowing it to sense its surroundings in absolute darkness.

Acetic_Acid_Spray_Nozzle.description: Equipped with a venomous tail tipped with a noxious spray nozzle, this arachnid-inspired component allows the wielder to spew a caustic jet of acetic acid, corroding armor and flesh alike with a sickening hiss.

Detachable_Decoy_Segments.description: Equipped with an arachnid's adaptive survival trait, this entity can detach segments of its multi-segmented tail as a defensive mechanism, granting it a deceptive agility and the ability to evade danger with eerie precision.

Glandular_Silk_Extruder_Tail.description: This serpentine tail, adorned with silken glands along its length, allows the entity to weave and extrude sticky, elastic threads at will, granting it unparalleled agility and the ability to scale sheer surfaces with prehensile dexterity, reminiscent of the most cunning arachnids.

Flattened_Aquatic_Rudder.description: This flattened aquatic rudder, a bizarre fusion of arachnid and aquatic biology, acts as an elongated, flat tail that dramatically enhances swimming speed and agility, granting the creature the ability to execute swift, underwater dashes.

Heavily_Bulbous_Fat_Storage.description: This arachnid's thick, bulbous tail serves as a vital storage organ, bulging with reserves that enhance its constitution but hinder its agility, granting it resilience against knockback while weighing it down.

Barbed_Anchoring_Spike.description: The Barbed Anchoring Spike is a formidable, chitinous appendage that sprouts from the tail of arachnid-like creatures, adorned with sharp barbs that allow them to anchor themselves to sheer surfaces, enhancing their climbing prowess and bolstering their physical strength.

Stridulating_Rattle_Tail.description: The Stridulating Rattle Tail is a sinister arachnid appendage, covered in fine, sharp spines that resonate with a bone-chilling hum when shaken, capable of both enhancing the wearer's charisma to command fear and reducing their stealth, making their presence more menacing and audible.

Web_Vibration_Damping_Plumb.description: This arachnid tail, adorned with intricate web patterns, not only serves as a mesmerizing display of the creature's craftsmanship but also acts as a vibration damping mechanism, allowing the creature to move silently and undetected, enhancing its perception in dark and treacherous environments.
